namespace_note: Keyed episodes from the P0-06 test namespace, indices 2000..2199, purpose 'final'. A separate labeled namespace: not comparable to runs/eval.json (legacy unkeyed seeds 5000..5499 with training-seed overlap) and not the DA8 keyed comparison (test indices 0..499 on the 12x12 classic board only).

bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap over paired per-episode differences, resampling episode keys with replacement
